avoid_supplements.name: Red Yeast Rice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains lovastatin which undergoes same CYP3A4 metabolism as gemfibrozil; significantly increases statin levels and myopathy risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to discontinue red yeast rice immediately

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Niacin (>1000mg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive lipid-lowering effects with gemfibrozil may cause severe hypoprothrombinemia and increased bleeding risk; synergistic muscle toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; if niacin necessary, use low doses only with close monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C8 inducer may reduce gemfibrozil efficacy and alter metabolism
avoid_supplements.action: Discourage use; if necessary, monitor lipid panel more frequently for therapeutic failure

caution_supplements.name: Fish Oil (Omega-3)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive anticoagulant and lipid-lowering effects may increase bleeding risk; generally beneficial but monitor for excessive effect
caution_supplements.action: Acceptable with monitoring; assess for signs of bleeding and monitor INR if patient on anticoagulants

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10
caution_supplements.mechanism: May be depleted by fibrates; supplementation could support muscle function but lacks strong evidence
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation (100-200mg daily) if patient develops muscle symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases gemfibrozil levels unpredictably; potential for increased adverse effects and toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Advise complete avoidance of grapefruit and grapefruit juice; inform patient of cross-reactivity with pomelo and Seville oranges

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly increase gemfibrozil absorption and delay gastric emptying; minor impact on efficacy
caution_foods.action: Take gemfibrozil 30 minutes before meals for optimal absorption; consistent meal timing recommended

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase triglyceride levels, opposing gemfibrozil's therapeutic effect; increases myopathy risk
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol to moderate intake (≤1 drink daily for women, ≤2 for men); educate on lipid effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor lipid panel (triglycerides, LDL, HDL) at baseline and 4-12 weeks; assess for muscle pain/weakness and obtain baseline CK if symptomatic. Monitor liver function and renal function periodically, especially in elderly or those with renal impairment; gemfibrozil is contraindicated if CrCl <30 mL/min.
